trial_title: Subcutaneous Progesterone Versus Vaginal Progesterone Gel for Luteal Phase Support
brief_summary: It is well known that implantation of the developing blastocyst occurs during the luteal phase of the menstrual cycle when the endometrium is under the direct influence of Progesterone (P).Several prospective randomized controlled trials have evaluated the benefits of luteal phase P support in ovulation induction cycles and a recent review and meta-analysis demonstrated that it may be of benefit to patients undergoing ovulation induction with gonadotropins in intrauterine insemination (IUI) cycl
